verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an integration and agent-tooling platform like Metorial, but the evidence pack never documents batch or bulk actions across many items, whether through the API, SDK, or dashboard. Attaching multiple providers to one session (metorial-docs-6) merges tools for an agent; it is an adjacent feature, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
